system.description: You cause inanimate objects to move and act on simple commands, though nothing beyond what would be conceivable for the object's form. You must spend a Willpower Trait to activate this power, and may control a number of objects at once equal to your permanent Mental Traits divided by three (round up). Each object must be animated individually while in your line of sight, and remains animated as long as it stays within your sight or for up to an hour.
system.duration: Up to one hour or line of sight
